blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — A lawmaker called out a distillers’ group for supposedly using coffee farmers and consumers as a shield from additional taxes, as they proposed to place a levy on the product instead of a new round of hikes for alcoholic beverages. ACT Teachers party-list Rep. Antonio Tinio said this on Thursday after Distilled Spirits Association of the Philippines (DSAP) president Olivia Limpe-Aw suggested that the House of Representatives explore putting taxes on coffee instead of alcoholic drinks, as younger generations lean towards coffee nowadays.
